record.title: Capture stock ADC runtime inputs at the established pre-call stop
record.intent: Resolve the software input ambiguity for the complete ADC candidate sequence in one bounded stock observation.
requirements: Execute only if every required private control was accepted; run one frozen stock capture profile under the accepted calibration file fixture with unchanged APK and native library.

Require the inherited two DNA reads, complete programming transcript and remaining and tail checkpoints, accepted loader statuses and payloads, then stop with all threads converged before stock instruction 0x333ba8 executes.

Capture and independently decode the bounded matrix selector shadow and selected-series inputs; validate live relocations and source pins and preserve point-in-time uncertainty for any concurrent mutable state.
Add no synthetic register responses or new filesystem fixture and do not execute the ADC call. Reject unexpected accesses pointers state statuses or incomplete capture with preserved evidence.
Record stable system_server identity, final guest health, thread reap, package teardown and released experiment ports. Commit and push the conclusion before further guest work.
acceptance: A verified stock input snapshot or reproducible negative result is committed and pushed.
